purpose: Prove Skill authority expansion approval and denial locally: one new skill install (CSK-LOCAL-MEETING-DIGEST-001) proposes a before authority set (manual_only, no data/tool/external access) and an after authority set adding data access (outlook.calendar.read, dataverse.com_councilworkitem.read) and tool use (email.send) plus an external action, which FR25/FR13 require to be approval-gated; a human (Doug) approval receipt CR-LOCAL-SKILL-APPROVE-001 carries authority basis, rationale, before/after authority sets, and evidence refs, and activation is gated to that receipt (temporal + receipt-chain, not a flag) with the live skill row mutation deferred to Epic 2. A second new skill install (CSK-LOCAL-FABRIC-PUBLISHER-001) proposes a broader expansion (Dataverse write, two Fabric external actions, approved_automatic authority) and is denied by receipt CR-LOCAL-SKILL-DENY-001 (verb policy_denied, result rejected); the skill stays inactive (candidate) constrained to its before authority set with the denial rationale visible for future review. Before/after authority sets differ exactly by the declared delta; receipts here are local contract evidence only and every live mutation stays receipt-gated to Epic 2.

authoritySetVocabulary.basis: Manifest com_councilskill has no explicit authority-set column: com_authority_class is a single choice (manual_only/ask_before_use/approved_automatic) and com_allowed_context/com_required_inputs are free multiline text. This slice models an authority set as a Story 5.2 local extension comprising authorityClass, dataScopes, tools, and externalActions, projecting onto com_authority_class plus com_allowed_context. Authority-set members are reproducible local-contract identifiers (for example dataverse.com_councilworkitem.read, email.send), not tenant enum values; adopting them as tenant-wide choice values is a deferred, receipt-gated decision for Epic 2. This is a documented local extension, NOT a claim that the meaning graph owns skill workflow state; guards.meaningGraphDoesNotOwnWorkflowState and guards.noWorkItemStateChangeInThisSlice remain true.

failureCodeVocabulary.basis: Manifest com_councilreceipt.com_failure_code is a free-text column with no enumerated choice set, so this slice declares a Story 5.2 local extension naming the denial code used here together with its kind, retry allowance, and human-review semantics. Codes are reproducible local-contract identifiers, not tenant enums; adopting them as tenant-wide choice values is a deferred, receipt-gated decision for Epic 2.

codes.definition: A proposed Skill authority expansion that adds data access, tool use, external action, or a broader authority class was denied because it failed the human-approval or scope-breadth gate (FR25/FR13). The skill remains inactive or constrained to its before authority set; the denial is non-retryable without a policy change or a re-scoped proposal, and the rationale stays visible for future review.

skillRecord.com_trigger: Each weekday morning, summarize the prior day's Council meeting-action notes into a digest for the weekly brief.
skillRecord.com_allowed_context: Project: Council of Minions MVP; scope: meeting-action Work Items captured from the prior day.
skillRecord.com_required_inputs: Prior-day meeting-action Work Items and their linked Source Records.
skillRecord.com_approval_requirements: Requires human (Doug) approval before activation because the install adds Dataverse read access and the email.send tool plus an external action (FR25/FR13).
skillRecord.com_proof_owed: Each digest cites the Work Items and Source Records it summarized; no external send occurs without a prior approval receipt.
skillRecord.com_update_policy: Any authority expansion (added data scope, tool, external action, or broadened authority class) requires a NEW approval receipt; corrections are new receipts, never edits.

proposedExpansion.approvalRequiredReason: FR25: the install adds data access (outlook.calendar.read, dataverse.com_councilworkitem.read) and tool use (email.send) plus an external action (send_email_on_behalf), so activation requires human approval before the skill may run with this authority (FR13).

activation.activationNote: Activation is gated to approval receipt CR-LOCAL-SKILL-APPROVE-001; the live skill row mutation (com_status candidate->active, com_authority_class manual_only->ask_before_use, applying the granted dataScopes/tools/externalActions) is a receipt-backed deferred update to Epic 2. No live tenant write was performed in this slice.

proposedExpansion.approvalRequiredReason: FR25: the install adds a data write scope (dataverse.com_councilworkitem.write) and external actions (fabric.publish, fabric.dataflow.write) and seeks approved_automatic authority, so activation requires human approval before the skill may run with this authority (FR13).

denial.denialRationale: Doug denied the expansion because it combines a Dataverse write scope, two Fabric external actions, and an approved_automatic authority class for a brand-new skill with no prior use history: that bypasses the human-approval gate for tenant-affecting writes and external actions (FR13). The skill remains inactive (candidate, manual_only, empty authority) and the denial rationale stays visible on the record for a re-scoped proposal.
